synopsis: People choose jewelry, and jewelry chooses people. The jewelry store "Rohstein" has an unusual way of "maids selling jewelry". The store, located off the main street, is frequented by gentlemen, aristocrats, actresses, poor students, and all sorts of people who have heard the rumors. When they come across a sparkling jewel, their lives begin to shine brightly. A tale spun between gems and the people who desire them - a series of jewel-like short stories, delicately illustrated. synopsis: Today my cat-girl black cat is carefree as always! "If I had a cat like that I'd do my best everyday!" "I'd also want to live with this cat!" The acclaimed social media hit "Kuroneko-chan" series get serialized with over 40 original pages! A woman adopts sister black cats Kuro and Mame. Her wish, "I hope you both grow nice and big", has an unexpected result the next day when Kuro suddenly takes the shape of a human girl...!? Playing with toys together, begging for affection during work hours, yet blissfully ignoring requests and then getting upset at... Days with these free spirited black cats are full of happiness! This is a manga about the warm and kind daily experiences of two carefree black cats and the owner who just can't keep them under control! Contains over 40 original pages about things like taking baths or dealing cats that hating taking medication! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Mogura no Uta
synopsis: Tanibukuro city's Officer Kikukawa Reiji is the problem child of the police force. He doesn't always follow protocol and he enforces justice through his own personal morals. But it was that exact unwavering sense of righteousness that convinced the chief of police that Reiji was a perfect fit for a top secret undercover mission. He is given the task of infiltrating the Sukiya organization, the biggest and most dangerous mafia group of the Kanto region, and find solid evidence to arrest its leader Todoroki Shuho. But being accepted and trusted in the mafia means Reiji has to do unthinkable things and put himself in dangerous situations where one little slip and his life would be over. (Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Kimi ga Iu ni wa Inu no Koi
titleRomaji: Kimi ga Iu ni wa Inu no Koi
synopsis: "I just want to live my life listening to someone's orders and being praised..." Is that a sinful, unrealistic dream? Yet, that was the sole wish of ordinary high school student Akira Tamanoi. Days without dreams or motivation... One day, as punishment for being late, Akira is assigned to help the student council and meets the intelligent and beautiful student council president, Makoto Miyauchi. And then, something unexpected happens. Miyauchi constantly asks Akira for favors. "Please... thank you!" "You can't do it? You did well!" Without understanding the meaning of the comfort given to him by Miyauchi, Akira becomes completely engrossed in this suddenly realized dream... There he was, my wonderful master. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synopsis: "Understanding" is "Stronger" than a Sword! There is no magic without any weapons! But! This is the story of a man who wishes to live safely! "So, I've come to a different world." That man stood alone in a mountain full of plants and creatures that he never knew nor saw before. He goes down the mountain by avoiding encounters with a big slime (and bandits), and is caught as a suspicious person in the castle he reaches. In interrogation the female knight Ilius met at the imprisoned place, when talking about the bandits seen in the mountain, Irias, who was stuck in the search for said bandits, hurriedly strikes the bandits . My wish to be a brave man, or to build a harem? "I just want to live in a safe place" - a story that such a man survives the different world with "Understanding" as a weapon!
